rules.when: Same lineage group and the asset fits the new email unchanged (same artifact, new crop or new live content).
rules.never: Reuse an environment across different lineage groups just to save work.

rules.when: Same material family, different object or format (A04 entry card from the A01 letter stock; A06 slip from the A03 note).
rules.never: Derive across families whose mood conflicts (ceremonial seal into a security email).

rules.when: An approved asset fails QA (resolution, artefacts, dark-mode edges) or the founder asks for a revision; keep the slot, replace the file, record the superseded version.
rules.never: Regenerate silently; the old version is marked SUPERSEDED, not deleted.

rules.when: First asset of a lineage group, or a new message type the existing groups cannot carry.
rules.never: Create a new world per email.

groups.materials: morning still life on stone and linen, heavy cream stock, olive emboss
plain correspondence card, blind emboss, no environment
pinned note / desk slip, brass clip, pencil rule
clipped briefing sheet, ledger rules, narrow desk crop
ceremonial card, wax / blind seal, burgundy, brass
annotated field guide pages, botanical and architectural plates
magazine spreads, broadsides, art-history references — per campaign
